

# Setup
```{r setup}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
# source("02-Cell-type_scoring.r")

dat_dir <- "GNPC Harmonised Dataset v1/Clinical"

```


# Loading datasets
```{r meta}

dic <- fread(file.path(dat_dir, "Documents", "datadictionary.csv"))
meta <- fread(file.path(dat_dir, "SomalogicMetaV1_anonymized.csv"))
clin <- fread(file.path(dat_dir, "ClinicalV1_anonymized.csv"))
gen <- fread(file.path(dat_dir, "GeneticsV1_anonymized.csv"))
pidn <- fread(file.path(dat_dir, "PersonMappingV1_anonymized.csv"))
soma <- fread(file.path(dat_dir, "SomalogicAnalyteInfoV1_anonymized.csv"))
# prot1 <- fread(file.path(dat_dir, "Somalogic02V1_anonymized.csv"))

```

# Gene conversion table
```{r gene_names}

# fetch top associated probe from Stanford ADRC biomarker data.
prot <- fread("dataProt_SS-205063.probe_list.csv")

# match and get colnames (have to handle piped gene names and missing probe names)
prot[, seq_id := gsub("^.*\\.(\\d+)\\.(\\d+)\\.\\d+$", "\\1-\\2", ix)]
# prot[ix %like% "None", seq_id := gsub("None.", "", ix)]
# prot[, seq_id := sub("^(\\d+)\\.(\\d+)\\..*$", "\\1-\\2", seq_id)]

# merge
prot <- merge(prot, soma, by = 'seq_id', all.x = TRUE)
# prot[is.na(table_name)]

```

# Mapping baseline visits
```{r}
# filter by participants with genetic data? (10k pids vs 7500)
apo <- FALSE

# grab ad set
baseline <- clin[age_at_visit > 0 & sex > 0 & ftd != 1 & pd != 1 & als != 1, .(
  contributor_code, 
  sample_id,
  sequential_visit_number,
  age_at_visit,
  sex,
  race,
  recruited_control,
  ad,
  mci_sci,
  cdr,
  cognitive_test_battery,
  cognitive_test_score,
  cognitive_test_date,
  computed_cognitive_test_score,
  tia,
  tbi,
  cancer,
  diabetes,
  chf,
  copd,
  mi,
  afib,
  angina,
  hyperlipidaemia,
  hypertension,
  depression,
  anxiety
)]
# merge and drop CSF
baseline <- merge(baseline, meta[, .(sample_id, sample_matrix)], all.x = TRUE)
baseline <- baseline[sample_matrix %like% 'Plasma']

# merge with APOE
apoe <- gen[gene == "APOE" & variant > 0][, .(contributor_code, sample_id, variant)]
setnames(apoe, "variant", "APOE")
apoe[, APOE := paste0("e", APOE)]

# merge with PIDNs
if (apo) {
  apoe <- merge(pidn[, .(person_id, sample_id)], apoe)[order(person_id, sample_id)]
  baseline <- merge(apoe, baseline, by = c("contributor_code", "sample_id"))
} else {
  baseline <- merge(pidn[, .(person_id, sample_id)], baseline, by = "sample_id")
}

# trying to map diagnosis like in Vignette 1, but add flexible MCIs group
baseline[, Diagnosis_group := fcase(
  # AD (even if MCI also present)
  ad == 1, "AD",
  
  # MCI - be inclusive to recover most cases
  mci_sci == 1 | (ad != 1 & cdr == 0.5), "MCI",
  
  # HC
  (recruited_control == 1 | cdr == 0) & ad != 1 & mci_sci != 1, "HC",
  
  default = NA_character_
)]

# Last KNOWN diagnosis (carry forward)
baseline[, last_diagnosis := {
  dx <- Diagnosis_group[!is.na(Diagnosis_group)]
  if(length(dx) > 0) dx[length(dx)] else NA_character_
}, by = person_id]

# Flag diagnosis trajectory for maybe future use
baseline[, diagnosis_trajectory := {
  fcase(
    # Reverters (clinically unlikely)
    Diagnosis_group == "MCI" & last_diagnosis == "HC", "reversion",
    Diagnosis_group == "AD" & last_diagnosis %in% c("HC", "MCI"), "reversion",
    
    # Progressors (expected)
    Diagnosis_group == "HC" & last_diagnosis == "MCI", "progression",
    Diagnosis_group == "HC" & last_diagnosis == "AD", "progression",
    Diagnosis_group == "MCI" & last_diagnosis == "AD", "progression",
    
    # Stable
    Diagnosis_group == last_diagnosis, "stable",
    
    default = NA_character_
  )
}, by = person_id]

# simplified AD
baseline[, diagnosis_bin := fcase(
  Diagnosis_group == "HC", 0L,
  Diagnosis_group == "AD", 1L,
  Diagnosis_group == "MCI", NA_integer_
)]
baseline[, last_diag_bin := fcase(
  last_diagnosis == "HC", 0L,
  last_diagnosis == "AD", 1L,
  last_diagnosis == "MCI", NA_integer_
)]


# clean cog scores
baseline[, cognitive_test_score := case_when(
  cognitive_test_score == -1 ~ NA,
  cognitive_test_battery == "MMSE" & cognitive_test_score > 30 ~ NA,
  cognitive_test_battery == "MOCA" & cognitive_test_score > 30 ~ NA,
  TRUE ~ cognitive_test_score
)]

# convert MoCA
conv <- fread("Roheger_2022.MMSE-2-MoCA.csv")
setkey(conv, MMSE)
baseline[cognitive_test_battery == "MMSE", MoCA := fifelse(
  Diagnosis_group == "AD" & !is.na(Diagnosis_group),
  conv$AD.MoCA[match(cognitive_test_score, conv$MMSE)],
  conv$Full.MoCA[match(cognitive_test_score, conv$MMSE)]
)]
baseline[cognitive_test_battery == "MOCA", MoCA := cognitive_test_score]

# get final cog score
baseline[, last_MoCA := MoCA[which.max(sequential_visit_number)], by = person_id]

# Calculate MoCA velocity (slope per 365 days) for participants with 2+ visits
# In GNPC, no reliable time between visits, best assumption is sequential visits are per year 
baseline[!is.na(MoCA), MoCA_velocity := {
    if (.N >= 2) {
      # Fit linear model: MoCA ~ DS1V
      fit <- lm(MoCA ~ sequential_visit_number)
      # Extract slope and convert to per-year rate
      coef(fit)[2] 
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  }, 
  by = person_id
]

# Floor cognitively normal improvers and remove low baseline improvers
baseline[, MoCA_v_floored := {
  baseline_score = MoCA[which.min(sequential_visit_number)]
  fcase(
    MoCA_velocity > 1e-10 & baseline_score < 17, NA_real_,  # Exclude low baseline improvers
    MoCA_velocity > 1e-10, 0,                                # Floor other improvers
    default = MoCA_velocity                                  # Keep decliners/stable
  )
}, by = person_id]

# Create simplified race categories for analysis
baseline[, race := fcase(
  race == 5, "White",
  race == 2, "Black/African_American",
  race == 4, "Asian",
  race == 1, "American_Indian/Alaska_Native",
  race %in% c(3, 66, 77, 88), "Other/Mixed",
  race == -1, "Unknown",
  default = "Unknown"
)]


# drop others & J
baseline2 <- baseline
baseline <- baseline[!is.na(Diagnosis_group)]
baseline <- baseline[diagnosis_trajectory != "reversion"]
baseline <- baseline[contributor_code != "J"]

# collecting first visit
baseline <- baseline[order(person_id, sequential_visit_number)][, .SD[1], by = person_id]

# set up factors for contributor_code
baseline[, contributor_code := factor(
  x = contributor_code, 
  levels = sort(unique(baseline$contributor_code))
)]

# refactor with a "mix" column for N < 200
lets <- sort(
  as.character(baseline[, .N, by = contributor_code][N >= 200, contributor_code])
)
test <- c(
  setNames(lets, lets),
  list(
    "Mix" = as.character(baseline[, .N, by = contributor_code][N < 200, contributor_code])
  )
)
levels(baseline$contributor_code) <- test

# cleaning clinical data
cols <- c("tia", "tbi", "cancer", "diabetes", "chf", "copd", "mi", "afib", "angina", "hyperlipidaemia", "hypertension", "depression", "anxiety")
baseline[, (cols) := lapply(.SD, function(i) ifelse(i %in% c(0, 1), i, NA)), .SDcols = cols]

# check values
summary_long <- melt(baseline[, .SD, .SDcols = cols], measure.vars = cols)[
  , .(count = .N), by = .(variable, value)
]
dcast(summary_long, variable ~ value, value.var = "count", fill = 0)

```

# checking improvers for floored MoCA velocity
```{r}
improvers <- baseline2[MoCA_velocity > 1e-5, unique(person_id)]
table(baseline2[person_id %in% improvers, .N, by=person_id]$N)  # How many visits?
summary(baseline2[person_id %in% improvers, min(MoCA), by=person_id]$V1)  # Baseline scores?

baseline2[person_id %in% improvers, .(
   baseline_MoCA = MoCA[which.min(sequential_visit_number)],           # First visit (earliest date)
   final_MoCA = MoCA[which.max(sequential_visit_number)],              # Last visit (latest date)
   min_MoCA = min(MoCA, na.rm=TRUE),                # Lowest score ever
   max_MoCA = max(MoCA, na.rm=TRUE),                # Highest score ever
   change_firstlast = MoCA[which.max(sequential_visit_number)] - MoCA[which.min(sequential_visit_number)],  # Actual trajectory
   change_minmax = max(MoCA, na.rm=TRUE) - min(MoCA, na.rm=TRUE),     # Range
   n_visits = .N,
   time_span_years = max(sequential_visit_number) - min(sequential_visit_number)
), by = person_id][order(-change_firstlast)][, -1]

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Prepare data for visualization
fig_data <- baseline2[!is.na(MoCA_velocity), .(
  first_MoCA = MoCA[which.min(sequential_visit_number)],
  last_MoCA = MoCA[which.max(sequential_visit_number)],
  change = MoCA[which.max(sequential_visit_number)] - MoCA[which.min(sequential_visit_number)],
  n_visits = .N,
  time_span_years = max(sequential_visit_number) - min(sequential_visit_number),
  velocity = MoCA_velocity,
  velocity_cleaned = MoCA_v_floored
), by = person_id]

# Add trajectory classification
velocity_tolerance <- 1e-10
fig_data[, trajectory := fcase(
  velocity > velocity_tolerance & first_MoCA < 17, "Improver (low baseline, excluded)",
  velocity > velocity_tolerance & first_MoCA >= 17, "Improver (practice effect, floored)",
  abs(velocity) <= velocity_tolerance, "Stable",
  velocity < -velocity_tolerance, "Decliner"
)]

# Set factor levels for ordering
fig_data[, trajectory := factor(trajectory, levels = c(
  "Improver (low baseline, excluded)",
  "Improver (practice effect, floored)",
  "Stable",
  "Decliner"
))]

# Color scheme
traj_colors <- c(
  "Improver (low baseline, excluded)" = "#D55E00",
  "Improver (practice effect, floored)" = "#F0E442",
  "Stable" = "#999999",
  "Decliner" = "#0072B2"
)

# Simpler 3-panel version
p1_simple <- ggplot(fig_data, aes(x = first_MoCA, y = last_MoCA, color = trajectory)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = traj_colors, name = "") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, 5), limits = c(5, 30)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, 5), limits = c(5, 30)) +
  labs(
    x = "Baseline MoCA Score",
    y = "Final MoCA Score",
    title = "A"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

p2_simple <- ggplot(fig_data, aes(x = velocity , fill = trajectory)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = traj_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 10, 2)) +
  labs(
    x = "MoCA Velocity (points/year, raw)",
    y = "Count",
    title = "B"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

fig_data_cleaned <- fig_data[!is.na(velocity_cleaned)]
p3_simple <- ggplot(fig_data_cleaned, aes(x = velocity_cleaned , fill = trajectory)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = traj_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 10, 2)) +
  labs(
    x = "MoCA Velocity (points/year, cleaned)",
    y = "Count",
    title = "C"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

simple_plot <- p1_simple / (p2_simple | p3_simple) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.8), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

ggsave(
  filename = file.path("manuscript_figs", 
    "Supplementary_Figure_MoCA_Trajectories_Simple_GNPC.pdf"
  ), 
  plot = simple_plot, 
  width = 8, 
  height = 7
)

```

# joining proteomic data in batches of 1k participants into analysis tables
```{r prep_prots}
# For each prot file, loop through and read in samples/proteins into a master table.
dt <- lapply(sprintf("%02.0f", 1:12), function(i) {
  x <- fread(file.path(dat_dir, paste0("Somalogic", i, "V1_anonymized.csv")))
  cols <- c("sample_id", names(x)[names(x) %in% prot$column_name])
  x <- x[sample_id %in% baseline$sample_id, ..cols]
  return(transpose(x, make.names = 'sample_id', keep.names = 'column_name'))
})
dt <- rbindlist(dt, use.names = TRUE)

# merge with Symbols for analysis
dt <- merge(prot[, .(GENE, column_name)], dt)

# looking at proteomic counts
sample_counts <- data.table(
  Sample = names(dt)[3:ncol(dt)],
  Count = dt[, lapply(.SD, function(x) sum(x != -1)), .SDcols = 3:ncol(dt)] |> unlist()
)
table(sample_counts$Count)
# # by inspection, the older Soma sets are all in H, W and V, can be dropped
# baseline[sample_id %in% sample_counts[Count < 6000, Sample]][, .N, by = contributor_code]
# baseline[, .N, by = contributor_code]

# filter for older arrays
cols <- c(names(dt)[1:2], sample_counts[Count > 6000, Sample])
dt <- dt[, ..cols]
baseline <- baseline[sample_id %in% sample_counts[Count > 6000, Sample]]
baseline$contributor_code <- droplevels(baseline$contributor_code)

# filter for J
cols <- c(names(dt)[1:2], baseline$sample_id)
dt <- dt[, ..cols]

```

# Checking the shift in MoCA from baseline to last
```{r moca_trends}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

plot_data <- baseline %>%
  mutate(
    id = row_number(),
    change = case_when(
      is.na(last_MoCA) | is.na(MoCA) ~ "Missing",
      MoCA > last_MoCA ~ "Increasing",
      MoCA < last_MoCA ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE ~ "No Change"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(last_MoCA, MoCA),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("last_MoCA", "MoCA")))

# Create the plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = timepoint, y = score, group = id)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = change), linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Increasing" = "#2E7D32",
                                "Decreasing" = "#C62828",
                                "No Change" = "#757575",
                                "Missing" = "#FFA726")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("last_MoCA" = "Last MoCA", "MoCA" = "Current MoCA")) +
  labs(x = "", 
       y = "MoCA Score",
       color = "Change",
       title = "MoCA Score Changes") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())



```

```{r write_files}
baseline[, .N, by = Diagnosis_group]
baseline[, .N, by = contributor_code]

fwrite(baseline, file = "GNPC_baseline.csv")
fwrite(dt, file = "GNPC_table.csv")
fwrite(dt[, 1:21], file = "GNPC_test.csv")

# Issues with the cluster & memory, splitting by contributor
lapply(levels(baseline$contributor_code), function(i) {
  selected_cols <- c(names(dt)[1:2], baseline[contributor_code == i, sample_id])
  fwrite(dt[, ..selected_cols], 
    file = paste0("GNPC_", i, ".csv")
  )
})


```
